headers.olpuuei: la a thui. Olpuei la olkhueng dongah a cak la painah neh, tangnah dongah maryrs la aka duek rhoek ham kutdoe thapang a om kawng a thui.

verses.text: \s1 Egypt Ram kah Judah Rhoek Ham Capat
Judah khohmuen neh Judea kah rhoek loh Egypt kah a manuca boeih taengah, Kuttuuknah neh oltak la mongnah om saeh ka ti.
Pathen loh nangmih ham hno then han saii saeh lamtah amah kah uepom sal rhoek Abraham, Isaak neh Jakob taengkah paipi te ham poek saeh.
Amah bawknah ham thinko khaw, thinko thincaknah neh a kongaih saii ham khaw, thahluennah mueihla khaw nangmih te m'pae nawn saeh.
A olkhueng neh a olpaek dongah na thinko han ong saeh lamtah, nangmih taengah rhoepnah thoeng sak saeh.
Na thangthuinah hnatun saeh lamtah nangmih taengah moeithennah om saeh. Yoethenah tue ah khaw amah loh nangmih te n'hnoo boel saeh.
Nangmih hamla ka thangthui uh coeng ne.

Demetrius tue vaengkah, kum ya sawmrhuk kum ko vaengah, kaimih Judah rhoek loh nangmih ham ca kan pat. Te tah Jason neh a hui rhoek loh khohmuen cim neh ram khui lamloh a tloelh uh phoeikah kum ah kaimih ham aka pai citcai aka tlo koek pawn ni.

Te vaengah vongka khaw boeih ung tih, ommongsitoe kah a thii khaw long coeng. Tedae Boeipa taengah ka thangthui uh tih a yaak coeng. Te dongah hmueih neh khocang nawnnah khaw aka khueh uh. Hmaithoi khaw ka tok uh tih vaidam kaep ah ka khueh uh.

Te dongah tahae kah kum ya sawmrhet kum rhet kun Khislev hla dongah ah tah pohlip khotue he tuem uh laeh.   
\b  
\s1 Aristobulus Taengah capat

Judea neh Jerusalem kah pilnam long khaw, laipai rhoek neh Judah rhoek loh,  
 manghai Ptolemy kah saya neh khosoih la a koelh rhoek imkhui la aka om Aristobulus neh Egypt kah Judah rhoek taengah Kuttuuknah neh sadingah then om saeh ka ti.
Pathen loh manghai taengah khaw mamih benah pai tih mueirhih hlan khui lamloh n'hlawt dongah amah taengah a lenkoek la uemnah khueh uh.
Amah long tih khopuei cim aka vathoh thil khaw a vai.
Amih kah mawtkung loh Persia a pha vaengah tah a caem khaw yawk mahpawh a ti. Tedae amih te Nanea kah rhainu khosoih aka bi rhoek loh a rhaithinah tih Nanea bawkim ah maehpoel bangla a tloek uh.
Antiokus loh rhainu te yunah hamla a caii dongah a hui rhoek neh a man neh te hmuen ah a cip la cet uh.
Nanae bawkim kah khosoih rhoek loh khohrhang te a yaal vaengah tah Antiokus te hlang a yol neh hmuen cim kah pangbueng khuila kun uh. Anih a kun van neh bawkim te tloep a khaih pa uh.

Buengyai dongkah bangbuet te a huep la a ong uh tih lungto a palate pa uh dongah mawtkung neh a hlang rhoek te mat a dae uh. Amih te a cuk thil uh tih a lu a rhaih uh phoeiah amih te pilnam kah a voella a voeih uh.

A cungkuem dongah mahmih kah Pathen tah a yoethen pai saeh. Amah loh boethae la kho aka boe taengah laitloeknah a khueh coeng.   
\s1 Nehemiah kah Hmueih Te Hmai Loh a Hlawp

Khislve hla hnin kul hnin nga lamlong tah bawkim cimnah ka saii uh pawn ni. Te dongah nangmih kan yaksak a ngoe. Te daengah ni nangmih long khaw pohlip khotue neh, Nehemiah bawkim neh hmueihtuk aka thoh tih hmueih aka nawn vaengkah hmai a paek nah khotue te na saii uh thai eh.

A pa rhoek te Persia ah tamna la a sol uh vaengah khaw, khosoih hlang cuem rhoek loh hmueihtuk kah hmai te a loh uh tih a huep la tangrhom aka rhae khuiah a thui uh tah. Te kah hmuen te malh a phah uh coeng dongah uh long khaw ming voel pawh.

Kum muep a koe phoeiah tah, Pathen loh a ngoe coeng dongah Nehemiah te Persia manghai taengla a tueih. Te dongah hmai thuh te koep loh hamla khosoih koca rhoek te a tueih. Tedae hmai te hmu uh pawt tih a naeng khoilawk la a om dongah koep a puen pa uh. Te dongah te te a dueh uh tih a khuen pa uh.
Hmueihhlutnah hnopai te boeih a tawn uh phoeiah tah a naeng te thing neh a sokah a tloeng hno soah haeh hamla Nehemiah loh ol a paek.
Bawt a saii tih a tue rhai a om vaengah tah khomai loh a dah khomik khaw phuk sae tih hmai hlup a rhong dongah a ngai boeih hmang uh.
Hmueih te hlup a dom vaengah tah khosoih rhoek loh thangthuinah a khueh uh. Khosoih rhoek neh hlang boeih te Jonathan loh a mawt tih Nehemiah loh a saii bangla a tloe rhoek long khaw a rhoi uh.
Aw Boeipa, hno cungkuem suenkung Boeipa Pathen, nang tah rhimom, aka tlung, tiktam neh sitlohnah la na om. Namah bueng ni manghai neh rhennah la na om coeng.
Nang bueng ni na moeihoeih tih, nang bueng ni tiktam neh tloengkhoelh neh dungyan la na om. Namah loh Israel te yoethae khui lamloh na hlawt, a pa rhoek khaw na coelh tih amih te na ciim coeng.
Na pilnam Israel boeih yueng la hmueih neh doe lah. Na buham he khaw hoeptlang lam tah a cim la khueh lah.

Pilnam aka paekboe tangtae khaw tun coi lamtah, namtom taengah sal aka bi rhoek te khaw loeih sak lah. A hnawt uh tih a hnaep uh te khaw namah loh hmu lamtah namtom long khaw kaimih kah Pathen la na om te ming uh saeh.
Koevoeinah neh hlang aka hnaemtaek tih kut aka hlah te khaw dantat nawn.
Moses taengah ol na khueh bangla na pilnam he hmuen cim dongah koep phung lah.
Te vaengah khosoih rhoek loh laa a sak.
Hmueih dongkah hnopai a tlum nen tah a naeng a coih rhoek te longto a len dongah bueih hamla Nehe miah loh ol a paek.
Te tlam te a saii vaengah hmai hlup rhong dae hmueihtuk dong lamloh phuk a aa vaengah tah te khaw vik khum.

Tekah olka te mingpha la a om vaengah tah, khosoih tamnah rhoek loh hmai a thuhnah hmuen khaw, a naeng tui lamloh Nehemiah ne a hui rhoek loh hmueih dongkah hnopai a hoeh te khaw, Persia manghai taengla a puen pa uh.
Manghai loh ol te boeih a cae phoeiah tah a hmuen te malh a bing tih hmuen cim la a khueh.
Manghai loh amih te a ngaihnah hil ah kutdoe neh hno then te a paek.
Nehemiah neh a hui rhoek long tah te te “Nephthar” a ti. Te tah cimnah ni a thuingaih dae pilnam a yet long tah naphtha a ti uh.
\s1 Jeremiah loh Dap, Thingkawng, Hmueihtuk A Thuh
A vaivoek rhoek taengah hmai loh hamla Jeremiah loh a uen te thui tangtae bangla cabu dongah pakhat la tueng tih.
A vaivoek rhoek te tekah tonghma loh olkhueng a paek tih, Boeipa kah olpaek hnilh pawt ham neh, amamih kopoek ngaih bangla sui neh, cak neh, phuekhlaknah dongah phael pawt ham khaw a uen coeng.
Amah ol boeiloeih nen te amih te olkhueng dong lamloh a thinko a dong pawt ham khaw a thaphoh.
Amah te kah tonghma cabu dongah ni olrhuh khaw a dang. Te dongah anih khaw Moses yoeng tih Pathen kah rho a dang nah tlang la cet.
Jeremiah te a pha vaengah tah lungko pakhat te a hm uh. Te lam te dap khaw, thingkawng khaw, bo-ul hmueituk khaw a khuen tih a khui te malh a bing.
Anih hnukvai hlangvang rhoek loh longpuei te kutnoek a khueh uh dae hmuh uh thai pawh.
A ming vaengah tah Jeremiah loh a mih te a tlung tih, “Pathen loh a pilnam te tun a coi tih a sitlohnah a tueng hlan hil, a hmuen te mingpha boel saeh.
Te vaengah Boeipa loh he hno he phoe saeh lamtah Boeipa thangpomnah neh khomai khaw phoe ni. Mose kah olka neh Solomon loh hmuen nawnnah a khueh vaengah a bih tih a phoe bangla tueng saeh,” a ti.
Solomon loh bawkim a coengnah neh a nawnnah dongah hmueih a nawn tih cueihnah a khueh te khaw a caih la a tueng sak.
Moses te Boeipa taengah thangthui tih vaan lamkah hmai a suntlak dongah hmueih a hlawp bangla, Solomon khaw thangthui. Te vaengah hmai suntla tih hmaihhlutnah khaw boeih a hlawp.
Moses loh, “Boirhaem he caak koi pawt dongah a hlawp coeng,” a ti.

Amah phek la cabu neh Nehemiah poekoepnah dongah khaw a khueh. Te te cabu im dongah khaw, manghai neh tonghma cabu dongah khaw, David kah cadaek dongah khaw, nawnnah ham manghai kah khuenah capat dongah khaw om coeng.
Amah te tlam bal te mamih soah caem ha pai tih mamih kah khorhang boeih a long vaengkah a kawng a lam aka hma tangtae te Judas loh a coi tih cabu dongah a khueh coeng.
Te ni na ngoe uh atah hlang han tueih uh lamtah tah lo uh vaan.
Te dongah cimnah ka saii uh ham parhi te, nangmih taengah ca la kan pat uh uh. Te khohnin tuem ham te na kohuem uh van venim te?
Te tah a pilnam boeih aka khang Pathen amah kah ni. Amah loh a rho te hlang boeih taengah khaw, manghainah khaw, khosoihnah khaw, ciimnah khaw a paek coeng.

A olkhueng dongkah olkhueh bangla, Pathen dongah ngaiuepnah n'khueh uh bangla mamih soah sitlohnah a khueh pawn ni. Mamih he vaan hmuen boeih lamloh hmuen cim la n'coi pawn ni. Yoethae koek khui lamloh mamih he n'hlawt tih a hmuen te a cim sak coeng.   
\b  
\s1 Cadaekung kah Olrhannah
Judas Makkabi neh a manuca rhoek, bawkim puei a cimnah neh hmueihtuk nawnnah cil,
Antiokus Epiphanes neh a capa Eupotor taengkah vathohnah,
Judah phung ham thinom la aka vathoh rhoek taengah vaan lamloh aka pai kopoekrhainah cil ni. Te vaengah a hlangmi la yol uh dae khohmuen tom te a loh uh tih hlanglueng hlangping a haek uh.

Te dongah bawkimkah kawn te koep a loh uh tih diklai pum ah khaw thang uh coeng. Khopuei te koep a thoh uh tih a phae uh dalh olkhueng te khaw koep a pai sak uh. Te vaengah Boeipa loh amih taengah rhennah neh haidamnah a bahoeng a khueh.
He boeih he tah Cyrenne Jason loh a cabu panga la a khueh coeng. Te dae cabu pakhat dongah a toibawt la tueng sak ham ka cai uh.
A kawng lam aka phul paluep khaw, khokhuen kah cil tae aka ngaih loh olka muep a yet dongah a kuelka pah te khaw ka poek uh.
Tae aka ngaih loh a yoei la tae saeh lamtah aka kuem ham neh a tae boeih ham hoeikhangnah la om saeh ka ti uh.
Ka boem uh he khaw kaimih ham thakthaenah la khoeng om tih, olka a phoeng pawt dongah hlan tui neh ih khaw ka tal uh coeng.
Hlang khat loh buhkoknah a saii vaengah hlang tloe ham a rhoeikhangnah a tlap he a yoei moenih. Tedae a yet kah a uemnah ham tah thakthaenah a rhainah khaw kohoenah neh phat ka ueh mai eh.
a kawng a tip te tah lamhma kah cabu aka daekkung kah a hut la om vetih, a toi la bawt ah daek ham tah kaimih loh tha ka huel mai eh.
Imsa boei loh im pum a sak ham te a poek. Tedae si aka hluk long tah im thoeihcam ham, picainah he aka rhoeprhui koi te a poek.
Tuengrhuem cil aka daek loh a hmuethma rhep a ming, olka te a hnukhma la sawt tih, dumlai la a tip la a thui te a hutnah.
Tedae patoeng aka thui coeng long tah a thuingaihnah te bawt a thui vetih, khocueh rhamvueh lam tah thui mah pawh.

Te dongah mamih kah cilka te mah tong uh pawn sih. Thui tangtae te koep thui boel sih. Olrhannah te muep sen tih a khokhuen cil lat a toi he khaw hlang ang bibi banghui lamni a om eh.   
\b
\s1 Heliodorus kah Jerusalem a Phanah
Khosoih ham Onias kah hingcimnah neh halangnah te a ngaih pawt dongah olkhueng te rhep a vai tih khopuei cim neh a kaepvai tah ngaimongnah he paa tlaih pawh.
Te dongah manghai amamih long pataeng khohmuen te a hinyanah tih kutdoe then neh bawkim te a thangpom uh.
Asia manghai Seleucus long pataeng thothuengnah bibi te aka tukkai dongah hnonah ham boeih te amah kah mangmu dongkah ni a yueh tih a hnonah.
Tedae Bejamin koca kah hlang pakhat a ming ah Simon tah bawkim kah rhoiboei la om tih khopuei hnoyoih hmuen taemrhainah dongah ah khosoih ham rhoek taengah a kovai pawh.
Anih loh Onias te a noeng pawt vaengah tah Tarsus kah Apollonius taengla cet. Apollonius he tah Phonicia neh Coelesyria kah a khoboei tue vaengkah coeng ni.

Te phoeiah Jesrusalem ah thakvoh te khaw tih, tangka ciim tae lek pawt khaw, te tangka a tarhing thui thai lek pawt pawt khaw, te kah tangka te hmueihhlutnah dongkah a thum pawt khaw, manghai kat taemrhainah dongah khueh koinih a coeng thainah kawng te khaw a thui pah.

Apollonius neh manghaia hum uh vaengah te tah a taengah a thui pa bangla patoeng a puen pah. Te dongah manghai loh amah kah olka dongah hutnah aka khueh Heliodorud te a tuek. Te phoeiah khueh tawn kawng a yaak te boeih puen pah ham ol a paek.
Te dongah Heliodorus tah a yincaehnah te koe a tong tih, Coelesria neh Phoenicia te hip hamla cet. Tedae anih te manghai kah poeknah te thoeng sak ham ni a caeh.
Jerusalem a pha vaengah tah khopuei kah khosoih rhoek loh omngaih la a doe uh. Te vaengah a caehnah a kawng te phoeih a phoe tih a hmuethma a tak la metla a om te khaw koep a dawt.
Te vaengah khosoih loh tangka aka cuem rhoek te tah nuhmai neh cadah rhoek kah,

tangka a ngen tah Tobias capa Hyrcanus kah ni. Anih te a paihmuen khaw hlang rhoi la a om khaw, tangka a pum boeih la cak talen ya li, su ya hnih a om khaw, Simo hlang rhalawt loh ol laithae a thui te khaw, a thui pah.

Te phoeiah pilnam loh hmuencim ah a khueh he a thae la hnonah a coeng pawt khaw, diklai pum loh a hinyahnah bawkim poeih tarha a coeng pawt khaw rhep a thui pah.   
\s1 Heliodorus loh Bawkim Reth a Ngaih
Tedae Heliodorus loh manghai kah olpaek a om coeng dongah, “Metla olka om cakhaw manghai kah thakvoh khuila kun saeh,” a ti.

Te dongah tangka te sawt hamla khohnin a khueh tih cet.  
 Te vaengah khopuei pum te a ngaihmang te a phoeng mai moenih.
Khosoih rhoek khaw phuekhlak uh tih a khosoih himbai neh hmueihtuk hmaiah a bakuep doela vaan te a khue uh. A thakvok neh a olkhueng bangla a paek tangka te cuem hmuet la a khoem ham thangthui uh.
Khosoih kah a muei a hmuh uh vaengah a lungkoe hlut a toeh bangla a tloh pa uh. A maelhmai neh a suisak khaw thovael uh tih a hinglu khaw patang uh.
Hlang soah mueirhih neh pumrho thuennah loh a pha. A thinko khuiah tlo la a kaem te aka hmui boeih taengah phaeng tueng.
Hmuencim te yah a phueih hamla a om coeng dogah pilnam khaw rhaengpuei kah huithuinah khueh ham, yutet la a im lamloh koe suntla uh.
Huta rhoek loh a sukbam ah tlamhnin a yen uh tih longpuei ah kuk uh. Huta ca rhoek a ngen tah im ah om tih vongka ah pai uh. A ngen tah vongka ah pai tih a ngen tah bangbuet ah moe uh.
Vaan la kut a phuel uh tih huithuinah boeih a khueh uh.

Pilnam boeih loh a bakuep uh tih khosoih rhoek loh patang a khang te lungma a ming uh.   
\s1 Boeipa loh Bawkim A Tungaep
Tangka tung te a khoem tih a sueng hamla a tung te khoembael saeh tila tlungthang Boeipa te a khue uh.

Tedae thakvoh taeng te a taengom ne a pha rhoi. Tlungluen mueihla neh cungkuem kah anaa aka khueh tah aka tlung soeh Heliodurus te a hui taengah a phoe pa khung daeng. Pathen kah thaomnah loh a tuuk dongah amih te rhihnah neh a mae hma uh.

Amih taengah kamrhui rhimom neh, mangrhang dongkah aka ngol kah a tlung hala la Heliodorus te a cuk thil tih a hmai khomae anih te a cawt. Marhang dongkah aka ngol te a pumcu neh kutpom te khaw sui kak la tueng.

Cadong rhoi khaw anih taengah, thaom tloe la, thenrhuep thangpom la, rhimom himbai neh a thoeng pah. A kaep ah rhirha pai rhoi tih annih te taemtaem a boh rhoi dongah a pum dongah phing hluktuk la a tloh pah.
Cirhong la tlup a bung vaengah tah anih te a hmuep loh muelh a thing. Te dongah a paco uh phoeiah pa dongah a yalh sak uh.

Ani loh thakvoh te a taengom boeih neh takuektakuek a paa dae amah khaw a bom uh thai mueh la a khuen uh. Pathen kah thaomnah tlungluen te a ming uh.   
\s1 Onias tah Heliodorus ham Thangthui
Pathen kah khabannah a om coeng dongah olmueh la rha uh tih yalh coeng. A hoeihnah ham ngaiuepnah khaw tal coeng.

Te vaengah a hmuen cim hamla kopoekrhai aka saii Boeipa te a koeh uh. Kolkalh rhuet ah rhihnah neh pangngawlnah aka bae bawkim te khaw tlungthang Boeipa a phoe coeng dongah omngaihnah, kohoennah neh bae.
Heliodorus kah a paya a ngen long tah a mal hong neh aka yalh Heliodorus te hingnah koep a dangnah ham Khohni te khue mai laeh tila Onias te koe a hloep uh.
Te dongah khosoih ham rhoek long khaw, Judah rhoek loh Helidorus soah boethae a saii uh uh a thailatnah a tila poek ve ti khaw a rhih uh.

Te dongah khosoih ham loh dawthnah a saii pah. Te vaengah amah cadong rhoi te Heliodorus taengah a phoe vaengkah himbai te phek a bai rhoi te a pai pah. Te dongah, “khosoih ham Onias ngaithuen neh. Boeipa ham nih na hingnah te nang taengah m'paek.

Na hmuh bangla anih he vaan loh a ngawn coeng. Pathen kah thaomnah rhimom te pinam pum taengah yaak sak,” a ti nah tih vik hma rhoi.   
\s1 Heliodorus loh Hingnah a tho
Te phoeiah Heliodorus loh Boeipa taengah hmueih a nawn tih a hingnah tah Khangkung kah ni tila olcaeng a lenkoek neh a toem a ngam.
Amih neh rhep a hmuh coeng dongah sosang Pathen kah khoboe kawng te hlang boeih taengah laipai la a khueh. Onias te a phih phoeih a caem neh manghai taengla mael.
Manghai loh Jerusalem ah caem la tueih ham tah mebang hlang lae tueih ah a then eh? tila a dawt hatah,
na rhal neh a uknah dongah boekoek a om atah anih te tueih. Anih a toel vetih a hing pueng atah na taengla ha mael bitni. Kekah hmuen ah ke Pathen kah thaomnah om dae lah ko.
Amah te vaan ah om coeng tih a hmuen cim te a dawn hueltue dongah bomnah a paek. Te dongah hmuencim aka phae ham aka cet tah a ngawn tih a phae,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

He tah Heliodorun kawng neh, a thakvoh a khoembael nah cil ni.   
\b
\s1 Simon loh Onias Angawn
Simon kawng te thui tangtae coeng ni. A khohmuen soah tangka kawng te hlang taengla puen. Onias te khaw a soeh sal. Heliodorus te khaw a vueh tih boethae aka sai kung tah Onias ni a ti nah.
Khopuei ham aka hoeikhang, a pacaboeina aka tungaep, olkhueng dongah aka tlungmu vik te Simon loh barhan taengah hlang thae la a yoih.
Te bang oltloeknah long te thinah a rhoeng sak tih Simon aka paipuei rhoek loh hlang ngawnnah ham tha aka phoh la om coeng.
Khingkhoeknah yet coeng tih Coelesyria neh Phoenicia kah khoboei Menestheus capa Apollonius loh Simon kah laithae a paipuei te khaw Onias loh a ming.
Te dongah a pacaboeinah dongah khotohnah om pawt ham, langya neh a huep ah khaw, pilnam boeih ham te manghai taengah a thui.

Manghai loh rhaengpuei taengah a ngai huet pawt koinih khosaknah loh rhoepnah om pawt vetih Simon kah a angvawk te khaw bawt mahpawh tila a hmuh dongah ni.   
\s1 Jason kah Tlaihvong nah
Seleucus te a duek nen tah Epiphanes la a khue Anitochus loh ram te a ngol thi. Te vaengah Onias mana Jason loh khosoih ham ne a huen loh neh a bi.
Anih long te manghai taengah tah, cak talent yathum sawmrhuk neh, a tloe thahuelnah te mangmu la talent sawmrhet kam pae eh a ti nah.
Te phoeiah khaw, hlangnoe pum ham luemnah hmuen sak ham neh, Jerusalem kah pilnam boeih te Antiok kah khosa la om ham saithainah nan paek atah tangka ya sawmnga kan thap thil eh a ti nah.
Jason te manghai loh ngolhmuen a paek coeng atah a pacaboeina taengah Greek kah khosaknah singyoe vai hamla te a saii.

Roman rhoek neh huitai la om hamla Johan napa Eupolemus cet tih paya a om vaengah Judah rhoek ham ko a hlawt pah manghai olkhueh te khaw vik a rhoe. Olkhueng kah khosing te a phae tih olkhueng neh aka kingkalh khosing te lat a thawt.
Rhalmah im taengkah luemnah hmuen a thoh te a thahlue tih, hlangcong cadong hlang rhoek te Greek rhoek kah lumuek hamla tha a paek.
Jason kah a halangnah he a khawk coeng dongah te bang Greek khosing neh kholong kah khosing long he muep a et uh. Anih ngawn tah hlang rhalawt la om tih, khosoih ham taktak la a om pai moenih.
